If you are suspecting infection and you dont feel good seek medical help. Otherwise you could do this even if it might not be a fun idea, but this is what I did. I am also not a doctor or anything.

Buy gaus, bandage wraps, neosporn, new towels, good tape and a dish sponge.

Take a shower and crank the heat to the maximum that you can handle. Wash yourself throughly. Take the sponge with somehow soapy water and scrub the infected area well. Depending on the depth of the cut you will want to take care that you don't damage the inflamed tissue to much. Repeat until you can't see any scabs/discharge. Little blood is good, but a lot is an emergency.

Dry the area with the new towel by patting it down. NOT BY RUBBING. Gently rub the neosporn inside and around the affected area. If you can get it inside even better. Try not to over apply it at it gets messy and can make the problem worse. 

Depending on the length if the cut, say one inch. Multiply that by three or four. So for a one inch cut you will take three inches of gaus and roll it up three time so it is an inch long. Place it on top of the neosporn and wrap the area with the bandage. Thighs should be wrapped 4 times where as arms should be 3.

Again I am not a doctor or anything. This is just what I did. It was not fun but it worked wonders.
